name: Evexia Lifecare Limited
about: Evexia Lifecare Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the trading of pharmaceutical chemicals in India. The company also offers personalized healthcare solutions; and diagnostic solutions, such as early detection, diagnosis, and monitoring of health conditions. In addition, it is involved in the manufacturing of plastic granules. The company was formerly known as Kavit Industries Limited and changed its name to Evexia Lifecare Limited in January 2021. Evexia Lifecare Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Vadodara, India.
